liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this jazz-inflected version the ultimate, rating it five stars; Reviewer says the thirty-minute jam explores five or six completely different themes [10][18]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer notes the song cruises at a nice tempo with licks between verses [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-03-28.sbd.mtx.tobin.86833.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 224 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1973-03-28.mtx.dts.tobin.86896.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 224 min [2]
- **gd73-03-28.sbd-aud.cotsman.11473.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 203 min; rated 4/5 by 15 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the soundboard section lacks the quality issues of the audience recording [16]
- **gd73-03-28.aud-nourse.weiner.16886.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 201 min; rated 4.38/5 by 13 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the opening Cumberland Blues sound three stars, finding it acceptable; Reviewer says the recording is weak at times but still conveys the music; Reviewer rates the sound quality two stars, noting it hurts the ears [11][14][15]

## Around the show

- The show was officially released as Dave's Picks Volume 16 [24]
- Reviewer notes three-and-a-half hours of maximum chooglioogliness with few slow tunes [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-03-28.sbd.mtx.tobin.86833.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (65%-SBD/35%-AUD) [1]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred the SBD master reel to DAT and then to FLAC; Charlie Miller fixed a cut in Loser with a crossfade on the cassette master [1]
- **gd1973-03-28.mtx.dts.tobin.86896.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD(86459) + AUD(74682) [2]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred the SBD master reel to DAT and then to FLAC [2]
- **gd73-03-28.sbd-aud.cotsman.11473.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by J Cotsman; source: Soundboard and Audience composite [6]. Also: J Cotsman seeded the matrix containing both soundboard and audience sections [6]
- **gd73-03-28.aud-nourse.weiner.16886.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [7]. Also: Andy Nourse taped the audience recording, which was transferred via Noah Weiner [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by www.livebootleg.net: [コレクターズCD grateful dead(グレトフルデッド73年アメリカツアー）Civic Center Springfield](https://www.livebootleg.net/SHOP/GratefulDead0008.html) [27]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1973-03-28 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1973-03-28-ticket/) [28]
